overall: The AG found the Council did not violate the Open Meeting Law in the ways alleged: the February 3, 2021 remote meeting was accessible despite brief interruptions, and the October 26, 2020 meeting could not be assessed without a recording.

allegations.summary: Complaint alleged the Council's October 26, 2020 remote Zoom meeting was inaccessible because the public could not hear the discussion.
allegations.key_passage: Nevertheless, without a meaningful way to review the October 26, 2020, meeting, we are unable to make a finding as to whether this particular meeting was accessible.

allegations.summary: Complaint alleged the February 3, 2021 remote Zoom meeting was inaccessible because the public could not hear the discussion; the video cut out several times.
allegations.key_passage: Despite the interruptions that occurred during the February 3, 2021, meeting, we find that the audio was otherwise clear and members of the public could still meaningfully follow the proceedings as they occurred.
